question: Will this budget fix the pothole on my street?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: The documents do not say whether the budget will fix the pothole on your specific street. [1] The regional budget pays for pothole repairs on regional roads, with $2.9 million forecast in 2027 for spot road resurfacing. [1, 2] The Region also planned $130.4 million for regional transportation capital projects in 2027. [3] To find out if your street is a regional road or scheduled for work, you can contact the Region of Waterloo Transportation and Environmental Services department.

statements.text: The regional budget pays for pothole repairs on regional roads.

citations.quote: This department is also responsible for ensuring the safe design and operation of all Regional roads.
We keep local roads working safely through pothole repairs, grass cutting, flooding and erosion control, pavement markings, and more.

statements.text: The Region forecast $2.9 million in 2027 for various spot road resurfacing projects.
In last year's forecast, the Region planned $130.4 million for regional transportation capital projects in 2027.
